sources.title: IBM i Group PTFs with level
IBM i 7.4 — Maintaining and managing software (rzam8 PDF)

notes: Synthetic CLAIMS400 partition shows cumulative, HIPER, and database PTF groups at realistic levels.
asciiPanel:
WRKPTFGRP                        Work with PTF Groups                    CLAIMS400

Type options, press Enter.
  5=Display group   8=Display special handling PTFs

Opt  Group     Status      Level   Target      Description
     SF99740   Installed   25      V7R4M0      Cumulative PTF package
     SF99739   Installed   12      V7R4M0      HIPER group
     SF99704   Installed   8       V7R4M0      Database group

Parameters or command
===>
F3=Exit  F5=Refresh  F7=Page up  F8=Page down  F12=Cancel
auditNotes: ITGC change management: auditors expect current cumulative (SF99740), HIPER (SF99739), and database (SF99704) group levels. Compare level to PSP/Fix Central; MFPTF = missing fix from a group.
qmgtoolsRelation: QMGTOOLS PTF menu runs CMPGRPPTF/CMPHIPER for support cases; COLESADTA prints DSPPTF. Lab trains on WRKPTFGRP interactively.
